areas.narrativeSummary: Personal development at the school includes PSHE, SMSC, wellbeing and British Values, linked to the Six Strands [2]. The school reports that focusing on one strand each half term had a significant impact on respectful behaviour, with children, staff and parents using shared strand language after only one term, and an additional strand is now used each half term [3]. Wellbeing materials include the Devon Partnership NHS Trust Five Ways to Wellbeing poster, emphasising connection [1], and health education (PSHE) is listed among pastoral offerings.
